subject: Upcoming Company Event: Team Building Retreat
body: Dear Team, I am thrilled to announce that we will be having our annual team building retreat next month! It will be a fun-filled weekend with team-building activities, workshops, and relaxation. We will also have a bonfire night and outdoor games. Please mark your calendars for the dates and stay tuned for more details. Looking forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Your Name]
